WHAT: Full audio capture and processing pipeline before transcription

DEVICE SELECTION (5-tier fallback):
1. User-chosen device → 2. Last working (cached) → 3. System default → 4. First non-virtual → 5. Any device
Virtual devices filtered: Zoom, Soundflower, BlackHole, Voicemeeter

REAL-TIME AUDIO PROCESSING (background tokio task):
1. Stereo → mono downmix (SIMD-optimized, scalar fallback)
2. Silence gate: RMS < 0.001 → skip conditioning
3. RNNoise noise suppression (10ms frames)
4. AGC: target 0.3 normalized, attack 0.001, release 0.0001
5. Anti-metallic lowpass filter (smooths RNNoise artifacts)
6. Rubato resampler → 16kHz (sinc interpolation, linear quality)
7. F32 → I16 conversion (SIMD-optimized)
8. Chunks → mpsc channel (3000-chunk buffer)
9. Write to WAV (local mode only)

MEMORY PRESSURE:
>90% → drop frames, 70-90% → reduce quality, 50-70% → delay processing

STOP SEQUENCE:
1. Pause CPAL immediately
2. Signal resampling worker via oneshot
3. Wait 50ms for in-flight callbacks
4. Worker flushes buffers + resampler flush
5. Finalize WAV (hound writer)
6. Drop stream
7. Wait 100ms (macOS hardware release quirk)

GOTCHA: 10-minute recording = ~19MB in memory at 16kHz i16. No chunking — all buffered.
